verdict.rationale: Lago is API-first. Every endpoint has a generated command, there are curl examples against the events API, and an OpenAPI 3.1 schema supports generated clients. Docker self-hosting plus a repo script that starts a matching Lago version with a disposable local organization make it workable to run headlessly in automated or CI-like environments. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation or examples, headless auth/API-key guidance for automation, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
